events.what: T. Ace posts new lower bounds for snake-in-the-box in dimensions 10-13 (732/1439/2854 for 11/12/13) via heuristic pruned search
Orland et al. (Gukov group) report new snake records in dimensions 9-13 (191/379/746/1476/2924)
Bernatonis extends pruned-BFS heuristic records to dimensions 14-17

judgement.doubts: The bullet asks for the exact value of a(n); new record snakes are lower bounds only, so nothing is settled for any n>=8. The Orland et al. paper has no methods section and acknowledges TPU/GPU compute from an RL-for-math group; if a later methods account shows a learned policy produced the snakes, ai_role should become generated/assisted. Bernatonis record was not opened and is year-dated only (2026, after snapshot regardless).

corrections.why: F3: every event is a new lower-bound record (the record's own summary: 'no resolution of the general problem occurred ... the best-known lower bounds moved'); no a(n) for any n was determined, so scope is bound, not case.
F14: a progress row carries null direction; nothing was settled or confirmed.

other: kept, but the Orland et al. paper states no search method and credits TPU/GPU grants from an RL-for-mathematics group (competing_reading); no authorial account of AI producing the snakes was found, so none stands pending a methods disclosure.
